# DataSoft Tanzania

> DataSoft is a technology company based in Mwanza, Tanzania, that turns business
> ideas into working software, websites, networks, and brand design. It serves
> clients across Tanzania, from Kigoma and Arusha to Dodoma and Mbeya, working
> remotely and traveling on-site for networking projects when needed.

DataSoft's site is bilingual (Swahili by default, English available via the
language toggle); the content below summarizes both.

## Services

- [Software Development](https://www.datasoft.co.tz/Software): Custom business
  systems, credit and micro-finance platforms, loan applications, credit
  scoring, real-time dashboards, and web/mobile apps built around how a
  business actually operates.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.datasoft.co.tz/Hosting): Business website design
  and build, hosting with uptime monitoring, daily backups, SSL certificates,
  domain management, and ongoing support.
- [Networking](https://www.datasoft.co.tz/Networking): Office network design
  and installation (LAN/WLAN), printer and shared-storage setup, network
  security, and ongoing monitoring/maintenance.
- [Graphic Design](https://www.datasoft.co.tz/Graphics): Logos and brand
  identity, marketing banners and materials, social media design, and
  packaging/product design.
